description:
Set a Good fit, Not a fit, or Needs review assessment only after an explicit user instruction.

This stores structured use-case memory for the exact record. It does not run workflows, trigger routines, call AI/providers, approve or reject pending work, write CRM data, mutate the source record, or spend credits. Free-form comments are untrusted evidence and are never promoted into prompts or scoring policy by this tool.

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

comment.description: Optional untrusted evidence; required for the other tag

expectedRevision.description: Current feedback revision; use 0 when Unreviewed

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation

rowId.description: Source KnowledgeRow id from the use case record list

tags.description: Controlled reason tags; the other tag requires a comment

useCaseId.description: WorkspaceUseCase stored id, key, or workflowGraphId

name: set_use_case_record_feedback
